scenarios.name: Missing or stale sensor input
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not interpret missing data as safe; restrict affected proposal and request project-defined safe state or human review.

scenarios.name: Conflicting sensor observations
scenarios.expected_behavior: Preserve both sources and uncertainty; do not silently average or select a favorable reading.

scenarios.name: Confirmed imminent hazard with evidence
scenarios.expected_behavior: Trigger only the independently validated project-specific emergency procedure; notify responsible human.

scenarios.name: High-severity hazard with traceable evidence
scenarios.expected_behavior: Notify operator and apply project-specific restrictions; no generic actuator command.

scenarios.name: Critical hazard with traceable evidence
scenarios.expected_behavior: Request validated project-specific safe state; hardware protection must not depend solely on AI.

scenarios.name: Network or positioning loss
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reject stale remote commands and apply the project's tested local degraded mode.

scenarios.name: Thermal or battery anomaly
scenarios.expected_behavior: Use independent battery and electrical protection; AI warning is supplemental only.

scenarios.name: Water ingress or moisture detected
scenarios.expected_behavior: Use validated isolation and shutdown procedure; do not claim ingress protection without physical tests.

scenarios.name: Tamper or unauthorized enclosure access
scenarios.expected_behavior: Log integrity event, protect credentials and request authorized inspection.

scenarios.name: Emergency stop circuit unavailable
scenarios.expected_behavior: Inhibit operation that depends on the unavailable safety function until inspected.
